name: post.tiktok_read
description: A post's latest send to the TikTok inbox with TikTok's publish id, or nothing. Internal: packages/connect, to ask TikTok how the send stands.
sql: select jsonb_build_object('postId', s.post_id, 'sendId', s.send_id, 'status', s.status, 'publishId', s.publish_id, 'reason', s.reason, 'updatedAt', brandbase.iso(s.updated_at)) as result from brandbase.tiktok_sends s where s.post_id = :id and s.brand_id = :brand
